caseName: Lambert Run Coal Co. v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad
caseNameFull: Lambert Run Coal Company v. Baltimore & Ohio Railroad Company

opinions.text: Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. December 13, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari herein denied. Mr. Rush C. Butler, Mr. John A. Howard and Mr. Frank E. Harkness, for appellant, in support of the petition. Mr. Hugh L. Bond and Mr. George E. Hamilton, for appellee, in opposition to the petition.
